Name: Mary of Rome
Summary: Mary was a Christian woman in Rome whom Paul greets in Romans 16:6 for bestowing much labour on the apostles. She is distinct from Mary, the mother of Jesus.
KeyStory: Mary was a Christian woman in Rome whom Paul greets in Romans 16:6 for bestowing much labour on the apostles. She is distinct from Mary, the mother of Jesus.
LifeLesson: Quiet, hard labour for the Lord is seen and remembered, even when history records only a name.
